payload.body: JUST IN - Ed Gallrein will defeat Thomas Massie in the Republican primary in Kentucky’s 4th Congressional District, projections show. Read here: https://www.disclose.tv/id/ck9km3btwf/ MORE - A senior White House adviser described Massie's ouster as "basic political management of a party. You have to keep everybody on the reservation. Occasionally you have to shoot a hostage. The next one is Thomas Massie." @disclosetv
